text:
maya_ng: quick follow-up on last night's KV OOM cascade. wanted to capture owners/next steps in one thread so we can track closure.

igor_petrov: ack. can we first list which shards showed repeated memory-residency climbs vs one-off OOMs?

sophie_leaf: b3 and c1 showed repeated residency climb. a1 was a single OOM during retry surge. pprof shows many short-lived allocations but survivors concentrated in medium slab bins (256-2k). fragmentation ratio spikes correlate with 40–60s after burst.

liam_k: logs show eviction didn't reclaim because the residency gauge stayed ~78% (under our hard cutoff). concurrent minor GCs were clumped, causing CPU spike then full GC.

maya_ng: proposed action list:
- heapwalk + survivor histograms (sophie_leaf) — capture pprof, slab histo, and allocation stacks; ETA Thu 03/26
- shard soft-limit canary and backpressure (igor_petrov) — add per-shard soft watermark, return 503+Retry-After when hit; ETA Wed 03/25
- eviction/compaction experiments (liam_k) — test lower max_live_fraction and staged compaction windows; ETA Mon 03/30
- incident recurrence analysis (maya_ng) — correlate with deploys, retry storms, and traffic bursts; ETA Tue 03/24

igor_petrov: canary plan: soft watermark at 85% residency, hysteresis of 5%, reject new writes from non-critical prefixes first. will canary on b3 then c1. will include metrics dashboard tiles for residency_pct, slab_frag_ratio, full_gc_rate.

sophie_leaf: staging repro (commands):
```
# microbench: churn small keys with high TTL
./kv-churn --shard c1 --rate 6k --payload 2k --duration 12m
curl -s http://staging-c1:6060/debug/pprof/heap > heap_c1.pb
pprof -compact heap_c1.pb > heap_c1.txt
```
I'll summarize top alloc sites and survivor counts in the postmortem doc.

liam_k: experiment matrix: max_live_fraction = [0.6,0.5], compact_interval = [30s,120s], staged_compact_offpeak = [true,false]. will measure p99 latency and CPU delta. if compaction causes >30% CPU spike, prefer staggered compaction.

maya_ng: ops ask: include rollback steps and an explicit metric kill switch. also plan a fallback: route heavy-read traffic to smaller model variant or reduce KV cache TTLs if latency spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: kv-softlimit-canary -> staging->b3 on 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z (id: deploy-1767777777)

eng-oncall: scheduled 30-min sync Fri 08:30 PT to review pprof + canary thresholds. add to calendar.

igor_petrov: i'll post the canary checklist in the doc (smoke queries, eviction metrics, Retry-After observed, 503 ratio < 1% target) before rollout. please add any additional checks. :thumbsup:

maya_ng: thanks all. i'll update the central postmortem with owners, links to pprofs, and a recurring incident watch that fires if three shards show >2x residency drift in 24h.

liam_k: one more note: instrument a short-lived allocation sampler to get allocation-site heatmap without full heap dumps. helps reduce noise in production profiling.

igor_petrov: ack, adding sampler flag to canary.

maya_ng: great. closing this thread — followups in the postmortem doc and Fri sync.
